xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-shp:DisclosureOfNotesOnShareholdi:
1) This Shareholding Pattern is filed under Regulation 31(1)(c) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, on account of allotment of 1,16,87,704 Equity Shares of face value Re. 1/- each pursuant to exercise of an equal number of Warrants by JBCG Advisory Services Private Limited, an entity forming part of the Promoter Group of the Company on October 08, 2026. The Equity Shares allotted pursuant to the exercise of Warrants have been included in the demat shareholding, while the corporate action for credit of such shares is under process.
2) As on October 08, 2026, the total number of accounts belonging to all categories have been clubbed on the basis of Permanent Account Number (PAN).
3) Pursuant to a special resolution passed by Postal Ballot on October 27, 2025, the shareholders of the Company approved a cap of up to 49% on the aggregate foreign ownership in the Company.
4) As the voting rights on the shares held by Employee Benefit Trust under SEBI (Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity) Regulations, 2021 are frozen, ESPS Trust Limited will not vote in respect of the shares held by them.
5) The Employee Stock Option Plan is currently implemented through secondary market route, hence, there is no effective diluted paid-up share capital of the Company on account of ESOPs granted.
6) Details of Significant Beneficial Owners disclosed as part of the said Shareholding Pattern in terms of the SEBI Circular dated 7th December, 2018, read with the Companies (Significant Beneficial Owners) Rules, 2018, is based on the disclosures received.
